# Telegram Messenger
> Telegram is a cloud-based messaging platform offering fast, secure communication, bots, APIs, and developer tools.

Telegram provides consumer messaging apps alongside extensive developer resources for bots, Mini Apps, login, payments, and the MTProto API ecosystem.

## Main Site
- [Telegram Home](https://telegram.me/): Main product homepage with platform overview, features, and links to apps and resources.
- [Apps](https://telegram.me/apps): Official Telegram applications for mobile, desktop, and web platforms.
- [FAQ](https://telegram.me/faq): General questions covering accounts, privacy, security, and core Telegram functionality.
- [Features](https://telegram.me/faq#features): Overview of messaging, media, groups, channels, and other platform capabilities.
- [Privacy and Security](https://telegram.me/faq#privacy): FAQ section covering privacy model, encryption, and account security topics.

## Downloads and Clients
- [Telegram for Android](https://telegram.me/android): Official Android client download and installation information.
- [Telegram for iPhone and iPad](https://telegram.me/ios): Official iOS client download and App Store access.
- [Telegram Desktop](https://telegram.me/desktop): Native desktop application for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
- [Telegram Web](https://telegram.me/web): Browser-based Telegram client for messaging without installing an app.
- [macOS App](https://telegram.me/macos): Native Telegram application tailored for macOS devices.

## Developer Platform
- [Developers Portal](https://core.telegram.org/): Central documentation hub for Telegram APIs, bots, and platform development.
- [API Manual](https://core.telegram.org/api): MTProto API concepts, methods, objects, and implementation guidance.
- [Schema](https://core.telegram.org/schema): Telegram API schema definitions for types, constructors, and methods.
- [MTProto Mobile Protocol](https://core.telegram.org/mtproto): Technical documentation for Telegram’s transport and encryption protocol.
- [TDLib](https://core.telegram.org/tdlib): Cross-platform client library for building custom Telegram applications.

## Bot Development
- [Bots Introduction](https://core.telegram.org/bots): Overview of Telegram bots, capabilities, and platform concepts.
- [Bot API](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api): HTTP-based API reference for building and operating Telegram bots.
- [Bot Payments](https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments): Documentation for accepting payments through Telegram bots.
- [Bot Games](https://core.telegram.org/bots/games): Platform documentation for HTML5 games integrated with Telegram bots.
- [Bot Features](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features): Summary of bot capabilities including commands, keyboards, and inline mode.
- [Inline Bots](https://core.telegram.org/bots/inline): Guide to bots that work inline across chats.

## Mini Apps and Web Apps
- [Mini Apps](https://core.telegram.org/bots/webapps): Documentation for Telegram Mini Apps launched from bots and chats.
- [Web Apps API](https://core.telegram.org/bots/webapps#initializing-mini-apps): Initialization and integration details for Telegram Mini Apps.
- [Main Button](https://core.telegram.org/bots/webapps#mainbutton): API details for controlling the Mini App main action button.
- [Back Button](https://core.telegram.org/bots/webapps#backbutton): API reference for Mini App navigation back button behavior.
- [Closing Behavior](https://core.telegram.org/bots/webapps#closing-behavior): Guidance for handling Mini App close flows and confirmation prompts.

## Login, Widgets, and Sharing
- [Telegram Login](https://core.telegram.org/widgets/login): Widget for authenticating users with their Telegram accounts.
- [Comments Widget](https://core.telegram.org/widgets/comments): Embedded comments system powered by Telegram discussions.
- [Post Widget](https://core.telegram.org/widgets/post): Widget for embedding Telegram channel posts on external sites.
- [Share Widget](https://core.telegram.org/widgets/share): Button and widget for sharing links through Telegram.
- [Widgets Overview](https://core.telegram.org/widgets): Documentation for Telegram web widgets and embeds.

## Client Libraries and Tools
- [TDLib Getting Started](https://core.telegram.org/tdlib/getting-started): Setup guide for integrating TDLib into applications.
- [TDLib JSON Interface](https://core.telegram.org/tdlib/docs/classtd_1_1td__api_1_1update_authorization_state.html): Example entry into TDLib-generated API documentation.
- [Telegram Database Library](https://core.telegram.org/tdlib/td): Low-level storage library used by Telegram client components.
- [MTProto Libraries](https://core.telegram.org/mtproto/mtproto-transports): Transport-level details useful for custom client implementations.

## Security and Protocol
- [Security Guidelines](https://core.telegram.org/api/security): Recommendations for securing Telegram API applications and user data.
- [End-to-End Encryption](https://core.telegram.org/api/end-to-end): Secret chat encryption model and protocol behavior.
- [Perfect Forward Secrecy](https://core.telegram.org/api/pfs): Explanation of forward secrecy in Telegram secret chats.
- [Encrypted Chats](https://core.telegram.org/api/secret-chats): Technical details of secret chats and encrypted messaging.
- [MTProto Transports](https://core.telegram.org/mtproto/mtproto-transports): Transport protocols and connection mechanisms used by Telegram.

## Passport and Identity
- [Telegram Passport](https://core.telegram.org/passport): Identity platform for securely sharing documents and personal data.
- [Passport Manual](https://core.telegram.org/passport/api): API documentation for receiving and processing Passport data.
- [Passport Errors](https://core.telegram.org/passport#handling-errors): Error handling guidance for Passport integrations.
- [Data Security](https://core.telegram.org/passport#security): Security considerations for storing and processing Passport information.

## News and Updates
- [Recent News](https://telegram.me/blog): Official Telegram blog with product announcements and feature updates.
- [Telegram FAQ Updates](https://telegram.me/faq): Frequently updated answers reflecting current product behavior and policies.
- [Apps Changelog](https://telegram.me/apps): App availability page linking to current official clients and releases.
